m1-path-and-name-legs.title: scripts/verify_retirement.py: Violation, git ls-files surface, legs retired-path-still-tracked + retired-name-on-shipped-surface, CLI
m1-path-and-name-legs.imperative: Create scripts/verify_retirement.py exposing scan(root: Path) -> list[Violation] where Violation is a NamedTuple(leg, path, line, detail), sorted by (leg, path, line). Enumerate surfaces from `git ls-files`, never Path.rglob. Define the record-only roots with REQUIRED non-empty reason strings (an empty reason must raise). Implement leg retired-path-still-tracked (path-based, on the index) and leg retired-name-on-shipped-surface. Add a CLI that prints TSV leg/path/line/detail and exits 1 when any violation exists, 0 otherwise. Attest c1, then let the engine run c2.

postconditions.statement: scan() returns NAMED legs, never a bool; surfaces come from git ls-files; every record-only root carries a non-empty reason
the CLI exits 1 on the untouched tree and both legs fire
